--- 命令 ---
echo "===== 整段对话取证 $(date '+%T') ====="
/root/bot/venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import base64
f='/root/remote_ctl.log'
lines = open(f, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read().splitlines()
# 02:17~02:21 的核对调试行,全部base64
for i, l in enumerate(lines):
    if '[核对·调试]' in l and ('02:1' in l or '02:2' in l):
        b = base64.b64encode(l.encode('utf-8')).decode()
        print('D|L'+str(i+1)+'|'+b)
print('====DONE====')
PY
echo "=====完====="
